2.desc: 我方角色施放追加攻击时，装备者获得一层【功勋】，最多叠加<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>层，每层【功勋】使装备者追加攻击造成的伤害提高<unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>，叠满<unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak>层时，额外使装备者的暴击伤害提高<unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>。

When an ally character uses a Follow-Up ATK, the wearer gains 1 stack of "Merit," stacking up to <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> time(s). Each stack of "Merit" increases the DMG dealt by the wearer's Follow-Up ATKs by <unbreak>#2[i]%</unbreak>. When there are <unbreak>#1[i]</unbreak> stacks, additionally increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by <unbreak>#3[i]%</unbreak>.
